# Tellus

> Tellus is a browser-based 3D world and AI terrarium backed by Hyades. Humans,
agents, and MCP clients can share worlds, move around, shape terrain, place
assets, chat, and use portals.

## Primary Docs

- README: https://github.com/DavinciDreams/tellus/blob/main/README.md
- Contributing: https://github.com/DavinciDreams/tellus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
- Agent guide: https://github.com/DavinciDreams/tellus/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- MCP skill doc: https://tellus.gnostr.cloud/tellus-mcp-skill.md

## Live Surfaces

- App: https://tellus.gnostr.cloud/
- MCP skill doc: https://tellus.gnostr.cloud/tellus-mcp-skill.md
- Hyades world API: https://hyades.gnostr.cloud/
- MCP endpoint shape: POST https://hyades.gnostr.cloud/api/tellus/mcp/{worldId}

## Developer Notes

- Local dev: `bun install`, then `bun run dev`, open http://localhost:3344/.
- Checks: `bun run typecheck`, `bun run test`, `bun run build`.
- Public docs do not imply access. Hyades enforces premium/auth for protected
  MCP endpoint use and bearer-token minting.
- Browser `GET` on an MCP endpoint returns 405; MCP clients use JSON-RPC over
  HTTP POST.
- Passkeys are WebAuthn origin-sensitive; localhost RP-ID errors usually mean
  the origin allow-list needs to match the relying-party domain.

## Code Map

- UI and account panel: `src/main.tsx`, `src/styles.css`,
  `src/tellus-auth-ui.tsx`
- Navigation and collisions: `src/main.tsx`, `src/tellus-rapier-physics.ts`,
  `src/tellus-terrain.ts`
- Rendering and performance: `src/main.tsx`, `src/tellus-terrain.ts`,
  `src/tellus-scene-builders.ts`, `src/tellus-vegetation*.ts`
- Hyades/world clients: `src/tellus-world-client.ts`, `src/tellus-auth.ts`,
  `src/tellus-runtime-config.ts`, `src/tellus-urls-identity.ts`
